messages:

Date: Mon, 5 Jul 2027 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: model mix & token volumes (post-demo)

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier today. Quick recap and a few asks so we can put together an accurate pricing estimate and mutual action plan: 

1) Volume profile: you mentioned pilots and phased rollout — can you confirm expected monthly token volumes once you hit internal GA (best guess): pilot (month 1-3), early expansion (month 4-9), steady state (month 10+). A high/medium/low range is fine.

2) Model mix: you told us you plan to use chat for product Q&A, embeddings for semantic search, and a small portion for rerank. Can you give a percentage split by model type (chat / embeddings / rerank) and approximate seq lengths (avg tokens per request) for each?

3) Budget target / unit economics: do you have a target cost goal (target $ per 1M tokens or top-line monthly budget) that we should optimize for? If so, please share the $/1M token target or budget range.

4) Security/compliance: Connor will follow up on the SOC 2 evidence you requested; if you can attach any RFP/Qs or existing security docs that would help.

If it's easiest, attach a simple spreadsheet with the numbers — I can convert into a price model and send back a recommended config (model mix, quantization profile, and estimated $/1M tokens and monthly cost).

Next steps: if you can send the model mix and volumes by EOD Wed (7/7), I’ll get back with an initial estimate and recommended rollout plan by Fri.

Thanks —

—Marissa

Hi Marissa —

Appreciate the clear recap. Attached is a rough spreadsheet (exported from our internal planning doc) with estimated volumes. High-level answers below: 

- Pilot (months 1-3): 25M tokens/mo
- Early expansion (months 4-9): 150M tokens/mo
- Steady state (month 10+): ~1.2B tokens/mo

Model mix (steady-state % / avg tokens per request):
- Chat (customer-facing Q&A, mostly short interactions): 60% of tokens, avg 120 tokens/req
- Embeddings (semantic search + rerank features): 30% of tokens, avg 1,000 tokens/embedding call (we batch)
- Rerank (ML-assisted ranking, small batch jobs): 10% of tokens, avg 3,000 tokens/req

Budget / target: Our procurement team is aiming for ~$60-$80 per 1M tokens (all-in) as a target for initial budgeting. If you can show a trajectory to $40-$50/1M at scale with quantization & batching, that would be attractive.

Security: attaching the SOC2 evidence request and a checklist. Connor can reach out to our security folks if needed.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Gupta
VP, Data Products, BrightLayer
samir.gupta@brightlayer.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Jul 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: model mix & token volumes (post-demo)

Thanks Samir — this is perfect and very helpful. A couple clarifying questions before we build the pricing model: 

1) For embeddings: when you say avg 1,000 tokens per embedding call, is that per-text input length (i.e., average document length) or are you expecting we'll chunk and call embeddings per chunk? Also, are you using both semantic search embeddings and a separate vector store similarity pipeline?

2) For rerank: the 3,000 token avg — is that because you send full candidates + query context? Any chance you can share an example (redacted) candidate set size so we can estimate compute per rerank?

3) Pilot vs steady state: to be conservative on pricing, should we model the pilot at 25M as pay-as-you-go and then show committed reserved pricing for the 1.2B steady state? If you have any target timing for when you expect to commit to reserved capacity, include that.

Preliminary recommendation (based on what you sent):
- Chat: use a 16-bit quantized chat model for latency-sensitive queries and active caching for repeated prefixes; target unit cost goal ~$45-$55/1M at scale.
- Embeddings: use batch quantized embeddings runtime, chunking strategy to reduce tokens where possible; target ~$20-$30/1M for embeddings workload.
- Rerank: because of sequence length, recommend a mixed strategy — rerank candidate scoring on smaller model + occasional high-accuracy pass; target ~$70-$90/1M for rerank.

I’ll produce a short price model showing per-model $/1M tokens and total monthly cost for pilot / early expansion / steady state. Rishi — can you prepare the quantization and reserved-capacity assumptions (cost per reserved GPU/tokens) and I’ll combine?

Samir — can you confirm candidate sizes and embedding chunking approach by EOD today? If so, I’ll have the full estimate back by EOD Fri (7/9).

Best,
—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Date: Wed, 7 Jul 2027 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: model mix & token volumes (post-demo)

Marissa —

Quick answers:
1) Embedding chunking: we plan to chunk long documents into ~600-token chunks before calling embeddings; the 1,000-token number was an early rough average — the attached updated spreadsheet reflects chunking at 600 tokens. We use a single vector store for similarity searches.

2) Rerank candidates: typical candidate set is 10-20 hits; we send the top 10 for rerank, so median sequence length ~3k is correct given concatenated context + candidates. We can provide a redacted example tomorrow.

3) Commit timing: procurement is looking at a 6-9 month horizon to move to committed reserved capacity, likely starting in Q4. For now, pilot remains pay-as-you-go.

I’ve attached the updated estimates and the SOC2 checklist. Looking forward to the price model — if you can show a path to the $40-$50/1M target at 1B+ scale that would make the procurement conversation much easier.

Thanks,
Samir

Attachments: "brightlayer_volume_estimates_v2.xlsx", "SOC2-evidence-request.pdf"
